# `vector_normalize`

<!-- @generated by `cargo xtask docs-sql`; do not edit. -->

Normalizes a float vector to unit length using the specified norm degree.
Degree defaults to 2.0 (Euclidean norm) if unspecified. Supported values: 1.0 (L1 norm),
2.0 (L2 norm), float('inf') (infinity norm).

**Applies to:** Krishiv 0.2.0 and above. Spark: 4.2 and later.

## Syntax

```text
vector_normalize(vector, degree)
```

## Details

| | |
|---|---|
| Krishiv | Implemented |
| Group | `vector_funcs` |
| Kind | scalar (function) |
| Added in Spark | 4.2.0 |
| In Spark profiles | 4.2 and later |
| Arguments | [1, 2] |
| Deterministic | yes |

## Examples

```sql
-- vector_normalize, example 1
> SELECT vector_normalize(array(3.0F, 4.0F), 2.0F);
[0.6,0.8]
```

```sql
-- vector_normalize, example 2
> SELECT vector_normalize(array(3.0F, 4.0F), 1.0F);
[0.42857143,0.5714286]
```

```sql
-- vector_normalize, example 3
> SELECT vector_normalize(array(3.0F, 4.0F), float('inf'));
[0.75,1.0]
```
